column1: # tests/partlayout/witnesses.tsv -- [ENTRY-TABLE] E1's WITNESS ARTIFACTS, with
# the HAND class map and HAND rank fixture the independent evaluator reads
# (docs/design/compound_entries.md §3.6). Written from the EMITTED C of each
# pattern's default artifact, never from src/gen/part_layout.c:
#   class  the subject functions (a class token) and nothing else; the owned
#          and not-a-part functions are the evaluator's default (no layout)
#   rank   each subject's hottest call site, read off the default text:
#          R3 inside the search loop's retry (a second `rx_prefilter(` call
#          site in `rx_search_run`), R2 once per call, R1 a subset of calls
# NOT A WITNESS: an empty-language hybrid (`((?=a)z)`), whose prefilter body is
# `return 0;` -- gcc's interprocedural constant propagation deletes the part
# and its calls whatever its attribute (`noinline` does not stop it; only
# `noipa` would), so a `shared` request has no symbol to show.
# Every witness is a corpus pattern (tests/**/*.rxt), so a row is reached by
# setting a control on an artifact the suite already compiles (D163 add. 11).
# Columns: id, flags (or -), pattern, class map, rank map.
